title: bhaptics-http: HTTP REST bridge for bHaptics haptic hardware
description: HTTP REST bridge for bHaptics haptic hardware. Wraps the bhaptics-python SDK in a small aiohttp server so that any language can drive bHaptics vests, arm bands and gloves over plain HTTP, with raw per-motor control and no bHaptics Studio registration. Accepts motor values as a plain list of intensities or as sparse index/intensity entries, needs no bHaptics API key for haptics, reports which devices are connected (live with a key), and is documented against bHaptics' own SDK reference. Runs on the Windows machine where bHaptics Player runs.
